notes.title: Performance and QoL updates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024794/33390f6f808e0c9b23671ea998fb3c52c45623e6.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Game performance improvements.
[*] Minor quality-of-life changes:
Hint about quick reset added to the interface.
More intuitive display of active/inactive checkpoints.
Adjustments to default input and music volume settings.

notes.title: First update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024794/1d1a30881bcd8822aa62e83a4bcb572be757ea63.png[/img]I'm excited to share with you the new update added to the game.
[list]
[*] Jump Mechanics Update: The jumping mechanics have been adjusted to offer a more classic experience, as most players found the previous version too difficult and inconvenient.
[*] Wall-Running and Wall-Jumping Overhaul: These mechanics have been reworked for smoother and more intuitive gameplay.
[*] Victory Screen: A new victory screen has been added, displaying your completion time.
[*] Quality of Life Improvements: Minor updates to enhance the overall experience, along with visual and audio tweaks.
[/list]
